Landlord’s Failure to Furnish Services.

Landlord shall not be required to sub-meter or provide separate meter for any utility service serving the Premises but shall have the right to do so if Landlord so chooses.  Landlord shall not be liable, under any circumstances and however occurring, for injury to person, inconvenience, damage to or loss of business or damage to or loss of use of property which are related to any utility service to the Premises, and Tenant shall not be entitled to any abatement or reduction of Rentals or other sums, and shall not be entitled to terminate the Lease by reason of any failure to furnish, or interruption in, any or all utility services.

Landlord shall be required to separately meter the Lease Premises, or if master metered, to allocate consumption based on a documented, verifiable basis with Tenant audit rights. If any utility service to the Premises is interrupted for more than twenty-four (24) consecutive hours for any reason within Landlord’s reasonable control, Base Rent and Direct Costs shall be abated proportionally from the first hour of such interruption.  If the interruption continues beyond fifteen (15) consecutive days, Tenant may terminate this Lease for breach.
Section 2.  Partial Taking.

If any portion of the Leased Premises, the shared parking areas, or the building is taken such that the remaining square footage is reduced by ten percent (10%) or more, or such that patient access to or parking for the Leased Premises is materially impaired, Tenant may terminate this Lease by written notice to Landlord given within sixty (60) days after Tenant receives notice of the taking.

If a taking permanently reduces the Leased Premises by twenty percent (20%) or more or makes the remainder reasonably unsuitable for the Permitted Use, Tenant may terminate this Lease by written notice given within thirty (30) days after notice of the taking. Landlord may terminate if the taking materially impairs the operation or economic viability of the building.

If Tenant does not elect to terminate, this Lease shall continue as to the remaining portion of the Leased Premises, Landlord shall restore the remaining improvements to an architectural whole at Landlord’s expense, and Base Rent and Additional Rent shall be equitably reduced until such restoration is substantially complete.

If neither party terminates, this Lease shall continue as to the remainder, Landlord shall restore the base building and shell to an architectural whole, and rent shall be reduced in proportion to the portion permanently taken.

Section 2.  Subsequent Clinical Alterations.  Following the Initial Build-Out,

Tenant may, without Landlord’s consent but upon written notice to Landlord, install, modify, remove, and reconfigure examination rooms, treatment areas, privacy partitions, medical equipment, and related non-structural clinical improvements as Tenant’s outpatient service offerings evolve, provided such work does not affect the structural components of the building or reduce the base building electrical capacity available to other tenants. Any alteration affecting structural components, the building envelope, or systems shared with other tenants shall require Landlord’s consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld, conditioned, or delayed, and shall be deemed granted if Landlord fails to respond within ten (10) business days after receipt of Tenant’s complete plans and specifications.

Tenant may, upon at least fifteen (15) business days’ prior written notice to Landlord, reconfigure movable partitions, casework, and finishes within the Leased Premises, provided such work does not affect the structural components of the building or reduce the base building electrical capacity available to other tenants. Tenant shall confirm in writing that such work requires no permit, does not affect the building envelope, base-building systems, or fire- or life-safety systems, and does not reduce any base-building electrical, HVAC, plumbing, or exhaust capacity, and shall deliver as-built drawings to Landlord within thirty (30) days after completion. Any other alteration shall require Landlord’s prior written consent, which may be withheld in Landlord’s sole discretion.
